page0.text:
"I refuse. I can't trust you."
It's not only Lancer.
I don't want to go along with the ulterior motive of Lancer's Master, whose identity is still unknown, and is offering to help at this particular time.

page1.text: "I see. That's what your partner is saying, but what about you, young lady? You said you would go along with his plan?"

page2.text:
"...My plan doesn't change. If Emiya can't trust you, then it's meaningless to cooperate with you."
"I see, you're right... This is really disappointing. You really were my type."

page3.text:
Lancer turns away.
His blue back doesn't look back at all and disappears like the wind, just as he appeared.
